biography: Karim Ojjeh, a name whispered with respect and caution in racing paddocks, hails from the bustling streets of Riyadh. Growing up amidst the roar of modified engines and the scent of high-octane fuel, Karim's passion for speed was ignited early. His father, a successful businessman with a penchant for rallying, introduced him to karting at the tender age of eight. While other children played video games, Karim mastered the art of overtaking, his natural talent evident from the start. A defining moment came at the age of 16 during a regional karting championship. Down on power, Karim executed a daring last-corner maneuver, snatching victory from a seasoned veteran, a move that cemented his reputation as a calculating and fearless driver. After dominating the regional junior series, he moved to Europe, quickly rising through the ranks of Formula Renault and GP3. Now, at the peak of his career with Bronzo Oreadi, Karim is a formidable force, known for his icy composure and strategic brilliance.
drivingStyle: Karim’s driving style is a masterclass in controlled aggression. He approaches each corner with meticulous planning, analyzing every braking point and apex with surgical precision. Tire management is a key strength; he can maintain blistering pace while preserving his rubber, often gaining crucial advantages in the later stages of a race. He’s unflappable under pressure, a trait that allows him to make calculated risks and capitalize on the slightest mistake from his competitors. He is known for his late-braking overtakes, a high-risk, high-reward maneuver that often leaves his rivals stunned.
